title: 第十五章废里淘金第十六章暴富与吞金兽
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 叶凡转头，看向那一车车散发着焦臭味的废丹。
现在想这些没用。
不管这人是谁，他带来的消息很明确。麻烦已经在路上了。
马得水那肥猪办事效率挺高，消息估计已经在外门传开了。
那些想巴结内门赵师兄的家伙，随时会摸上山来。
叶凡走上前，解开一个麻布袋的绳子。
里面全是黑乎乎的废丹，数量惊人。
他抓起一把，放在鼻子底下闻了闻。
药性还在。虽然杂质多得吓人，但对合成炉来说，这就是最顶级的口粮。
“让我自己挖坑埋了？”
叶凡把废丹扔回袋子里，拍了拍手上的黑灰，轻笑一声。
“坑肯定是要挖的，不过，埋谁就不一定了。”
他转身冲着那几个还缩在旁边发抖的杂役招了招手。
“愣着干什么？把车推到洞口去，卸完货赶紧滚蛋，别在这碍眼。”
几个杂役如蒙大赦，连滚带爬地推着木车往废丹洞走。
叶凡跟在后面，手掌贴在胸口的赤金小炉上。
炉身温热，仿佛在回应他的期待。
这批废丹数量极大，只要给他半天时间，足够他合出一大批高品质丹药。
锻体八阶，九阶，甚至完成九龙搬血的第三转。
只要实力提上去，管他来的是疯狗还是恶狼，全给他敲碎了扔进地火坑里当肥料。
这名凝气弟子的真实身份是谁？外门那些“谄媚的疯狗”何时会露出獠牙？
叶凡看着最后一人消失在山道尽头，脸上的那点懒散收得干干净净。
风从洞里吹出来。
焦糊味，药渣味，丹毒混在一起，呛得人嗓子发苦。
换成普通锻体弟子，站在这里半炷香，皮肉就得发麻。再往里走，鼻腔出血都算轻的。
叶凡却往前一步。
绿雾卷过他的脸。
没疼没痒，只有一点闷。
他低头看了看自己的胳膊，皮肤完好，连红印都没起。
“九龙搬血，真不讲道理。”
叶凡咧了咧嘴。
这功法坑人是真坑，烧修为也是真狠，可烧完之后留下的东西，没半点虚头巴脑。
一转肉身，免毒，抗腐，气血强横。
别人进废丹洞是下矿挖命。
他进来，是进库房点钱。
至于那名凝气弟子的警告，叶凡没忘。
外门疯狗要来。
内门赵师兄的狗腿子要来。
content_en:
Ye Fan turned his head and looked at the carts of waste pills that smelled of burning.
There's no use thinking about it now.
Whoever this man was, his message was clear. Trouble is already on the way.
Ma Deshui's fat pig is very efficient in doing things, and the news has probably spread to the outside.
Those guys who want to curry favor with Senior Brother Zhao from the inner sect will come to the mountain at any time.
Ye Fan stepped forward and untied the rope of a sack.
It was full of black waste elixirs, and the amount was staggering.
He grabbed a handful, put it under his nose and smelled it.
The medicinal properties are still there. Although there are a lot of frightening impurities, this is the top ration for the synthesis furnace.
"Let me dig a hole and bury it myself?"
Ye Fan threw the waste pill back into the bag, patted the black ash on his hand, and chuckled.
"The hole must be dug, but it doesn't matter who to bury."
He turned around and waved to the few trembling handymen who were still cowering next to him.
"What are you doing standing there? Push the car to the entrance of the cave and get out of here after unloading the goods. Don't be an eyesore here."
As if they had been granted amnesty, several servants rolled and crawled while pushing the wooden cart towards the Feidan Cave.
Ye Fan followed behind, placing his palms on the small red gold stove on his chest.
The furnace body was warm, as if responding to his expectations.
The quantity of this batch of waste elixirs was huge. As long as he was given half a day, it would be enough for him to combine a large number of high-quality elixirs.
The eighth level of body training, the ninth level, and even the third round of the Nine Dragons' Blood Removal were completed.
As long as the strength is raised, no matter whether it is a mad dog or a vicious wolf, he will crush them all and throw them into the fire pit as fertilizer.
Who is the true identity of this Qi Condensation disciple? When will those "flattery mad dogs" at the outer gate show their fangs?
Ye Fan watched the last person disappear at the end of the mountain road, the laziness on his face completely gone.
The wind blows out of the cave.
The smell of burnt paste, medicinal residue, and erysipelas are all mixed together, making people's throats feel bitter.
If he were an ordinary physical training disciple, his skin and flesh would feel numb if he stood here for half a stick of incense. Going further in, the nasal bleeding is considered mild.
Ye Fan took a step forward.
Green mist rolled over his face.
No pain, no itching, just a little dull.
He looked down at his arm. The skin was intact, not even red marks appeared.
"It's unreasonable to seek blood in Kowloon."
Ye Fan grinned.
This technique is really a trick to deceive people, and it is really cruel to burn the cultivation base, but what is left after burning is not even half-hearted.
Once the physical body is transformed, it is immune to poison, resistant to decay, and has powerful Qi and blood.
Others enter the Waste Pill Cave to dig for life.
He came in to count money in the warehouse.
As for the warning from the Qi Condensation disciple, Ye Fan did not forget it.
The mad dog from the outer gate is coming.
The scoundrel of Senior Brother Zhao from the inner sect is coming.
